name: robot-skill-hub
description: Find pinned robot code and inspect source, license, environment and task evidence through three read-only MCP tools. Local source acquisition and preparation use the separate Robot Skill Hub Python CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Find pinned robot source and inspect exact preparation and task evidence.
defaultPrompt: Find public robot code for my stated task and explicit robot/runtime constraints, then inspect a selected record at its returned record_version. Report source pins, license, compatibility and task evidence. Do not execute code, install dependencies or publish project data.
